details.description: Production-grade RAG system with multi-agent orchestration, hybrid retrieval, and validation pipeline. Features DAG-based query planning with parallel async execution, semantic enrichment ingestion pipeline, and evaluation framework with retrieval metrics and adversarial testing.

Full-stack multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace built with MERN stack and Redux. Features checkout system with Stripe payments and order lifecycle management, admin dashboard, search, pagination, and review system.

AI-powered image SaaS platform with restoration, generative fill, object removal, and background removal. Implements credit-based monetization with Stripe integration and Cloudinary for scalable media handling.
AI-powered browser extension that extracts and analyzes video transcripts using yt-dlp and LLM processing. Features FastAPI backend for content analysis and offer detection.
Multi-author blogging platform built with Django featuring role-based publishing workflows, rich text editing with CKEditor, and content management with Cloudinary media handling.
Modular React-based video platform with reusable components and optimized UI rendering. Published as an npm package for easy integration into React projects.
